name: Rheumatology & autoimmune care (category guide)
summary: Joint pain / lupus / inflammatory disease — GP labs first, long private rheumatology waits, and foreigner fee honesty in public clinics.
body: Rheumatology covers inflammatory arthritis, connective-tissue disease, and many autoimmune pathways that look like ‘just joint pain’ online. Start with a GP for basic inflammatory markers before chasing a private rheumatologist — waits are famously long even in private. Public hospital private-patient booking exists; foreigners pay full fees without citizen subsidies. Functional-medicine ‘autoimmune packages’ are not substitutes for SMC Rheumatology when DMARDs or biologics may be needed. Corporate outpatient riders may cover consults while specialty drugs need separate pre-auth. Distinct from orthopaedics (mechanical joints) and from allergy/immunology panels. Category guide, not a ranked rheumatologist list.
